scenes.description: Observing a Green Leaf with a Magnifying Glass
Planting a Tiny Seed in a Flower Pot
Testing Magnetic Attraction with a Red Magnet

character_line.en: Welcome to the science lab! What does a magnifying glass do?
character_line.zh: 歡迎來到自然科學實驗室！放大鏡的功能是什麼呢？

options.en: It makes small things look bigger!
options.zh: 它可以讓微小的東西看起來更大！

options.hint: 放大鏡是用來觀察細節，讓東西看起來「look bigger」喔！
告訴 Benny 放大鏡是怎樣幫助小科學家做觀察的！

character_line.en: Look through the glass! What do you see on this green leaf?
character_line.zh: 透過放大鏡看！你在這片綠色葉子上看到了什麼？

options.en: I see tiny veins and patterns on the leaf!
options.zh: 我看到葉子上有細細的葉脈與紋路！

options.en: I have four books in my bag.
options.hint: 仔細觀察葉子，會看到細緻的「veins and patterns」葉脈喔！
分享你在放大鏡下發現的植物神奇秘密吧！

character_line.en: Here is a tiny brown seed! How do we help it grow?
character_line.zh: 這是一顆小小的棕色種子！我們要怎麼幫助它發芽長大呢？

options.en: We plant it in soil and give it water!
options.zh: 我們把它種在泥土裡並澆水！

options.en: We kick it across the room.
options.zh: 我們把它踢到房間另一頭。
options.hint: 種子發芽需要泥土和水分，用「soil and water」回答！
告訴 Benny 照顧植物小種子的正確科學方法吧！

character_line.en: With sunlight and water, what will the seed become?
character_line.zh: 有了陽光和水分，小種子會變成什麼呢？

options.en: It will grow into a lovely green plant!
options.zh: 它會長成一株可愛的綠色植物！
它會變成一支黃色鉛筆。
options.hint: 種子在陽光和水滋養下，會「grow into a green plant」！
期待小種子慢慢長成綠意盎然的小盆栽吧！

character_line.en: Look at this red horseshoe magnet! What does it pull?
character_line.zh: 看這個紅色馬蹄形磁鐵！它可以吸起什麼東西呢？

options.en: It pulls metal paperclips and keys!
options.zh: 它可以吸起金屬迴紋針和鑰匙！

options.hint: 磁鐵有磁力，能吸起「metal paperclips」金屬物品喔！
用小磁鐵吸吸看桌上的文具，回答金屬物品吧！

character_line.en: Science experiments are full of wonderful surprises!
character_line.zh: 科學實驗真的充滿了驚奇與樂趣！

options.en: Yes! Exploring science is so exciting!
options.zh: 沒錯！探索自然科學好令人興奮！

options.hint: 開心地說「Exploring science is exciting!」讚賞科學的奧妙！
跟 Benny 一起期待下一次好玩有趣的科學實驗吧！
